definitions.internal_layer_cohort: Layer1..7 only, io_release>=2000 and compute_end<=4000. Full uncensored I/O lifetime and exposed wait; all boundary-overlap waits separately summed.
definitions.io_lifetime: io_ready-io_release, includes queue/service/receive latency; not SSD busy.
definitions.prefetch_budget: previous_compute_end-io_release; equal to preceding same-request layer C under baseline.
definitions.wave_alignment: Only fixed-role inputs have matched all-Long-card waves by request-position*8+layer; mixed control gets descriptive modulo-C concentration, not false same-wave correspondence.

cases.label: raw160_one_l16_fixed_seed7

matched_long_waves.alignment: request position *8 + layer; retain waves with every Long card release and compute start inside [2000,4000)

long_modulo_C_concentration.definition: All warm Long compute starts modulo its C; descriptive concentration, not a matched-wave causal comparison.

cases.example_selection: Largest exposed Short internal-layer wait fully contained in warm window, tie earliest release. Long reference maximizes read-lifetime overlap only; not claimed to be the FIFO head/blocker.
